{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, showing lag instead of immediate sentiment-driven shifts",
    "When sentiment turns positive, model under-forecasts the price more than 1 Euro compared to true outcomes",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model over-forecasts prices above reality by 1-2 Euro",
    "Sentiment alignment rules: high sentiment (0.67-1.00) requires model prices 1-2 Euro below actuals, low sentiment (0.00) allows model to track closer to 64-65 range",
    "Mean reversion bias: model holds prices too far from recent extremes, missing the momentum the model should capture from sentiment",
    "Sentiment strength matters: weak sentiment (0.33) has 80% correlation between model and true outcomes, but strong sentiment (0.67-1.00) shows 100% divergence where model is always below reality",
    "Price level interaction: when current prices are at 62-64 range, model lag is most pronounced (2-3 Euro difference), resolving as prices normalize to 66-68"
] }
